about.

I'm Abisekh, a B2B SaaS Growth & GTM professional with a passion for driving demand generation, pipeline growth, and revenue impact for enterprise products. With 3+ years of professional experience, I honed my skills in go-to-market strategy, outbound execution, product marketing, and full-funnel campaign management.

I specialize in building go-to-market engines that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue. From crafting outbound systems and running ABM campaigns to sitting in on enterprise demos and closing deals alongside sales teams — I bridge the gap between marketing strategy and sales execution.

I am deeply committed to transforming ideas into results, whether it's crafting go-to-market strategies, building scalable outbound systems, or optimizing sales performance.

Enterprise Deal
Execution & Closure

Closed ₹3.85 Cr in enterprise deals by owning the full sales cycle — from building proprietary datasets and cold outreach to live demos, in-person CXO meetings, negotiations, and final deal closure.

The GTM Sales Process I Executed:

  • Data & Prospecting — Built custom prospect datasets, identified ICPs, and qualified enterprise accounts
  • L1 Outreach & Cold Calling — Executed first-touch outreach via cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn to generate interest
  • Demo & Product Presentation — Led tailored product demos showcasing value aligned to each prospect’s pain points
  • In-Person CXO Meetings — Traveled for face-to-face meetings with C-suite executives to establish trust and credibility
  • Negotiation & Deal Strategy — Collaborated on pricing, contract terms, and stakeholder alignment to move deals forward
  • Deal Closure — Successfully closed 3 enterprise accounts worth ₹3.85 Cr in combined deal value
